# ex 6
We have a sinucoidal wave with period $T=130ns$ and such wave was applied to transmission line with lenght $L=17m$ calculate ratio of the wavelenght to the lenght of the transmission line asume that wave velocity in the line 

sin wave $T=130ns$ $v=160,000 \frac{km}{s}=160 \frac{Mm}{s}$
$L=17m$
$\frac{\lambda}{L}=?=\frac{20.8m}{17m}=1.223$

$v=\frac{d}{t}=\frac{\lambda}{T}$
one period
$\lambda=v·T=160 \frac{Mm}{s}·130µs=20.8m$

$Z_{0}=75Ω$
$R_{1}=Z_{0}$
$u(t,x)$

step 1 reflection coefficients
$M=\frac{Z_{0}-R_{1}}{Z_{0}+R_{1}}=0$
$N=\frac{Z_{0}-R_{2}}{Z_{0}+R_{2}}=\frac{Z_{0}}{Z_{0}}=1$ full reflection

step 2 amplitude of incident wave.
$0\leq t<2\tau$
